title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Premium Business Credit Card Overview
summary: This document provides eligibility and pricing details for the Business Gold Rewards Card: minimum $735 personal credit score and PAYDEX 67, annual fee $200, carried-balance APR 17.99%, and cash back rates of 2.5% on operations spending and 1.0% on other purchases. It also covers starting credit limits ($37,500) up to $225,000 and notes airport lounge access via separate guides.
